name: Plan delivery routes that cut miles and keep windows
outcome: Daily routes meet delivery windows while minimizing miles driven and vehicles used.
measures: miles and vehicles against the previous plan
description: Assigning a day's stops to vehicles and sequencing them so each delivery window is met while miles driven and vehicles used stay down. Own fleet and contracted fleet alike, and the plan is the deliverable: executing it, and reacting when it breaks, is scm.track-shipment-exceptions. It is not scm.reorder-inventory, which decides what moves between locations rather than how a vehicle gets there. Trading cost against windows is the job; beating the operation's previous plan is a measure of it.
